title: Commission approves €13 million French State aid for fishing companies facing increased fuel prices due to Middle East crisis
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 May 2026 The European Commission has approved a €13 million French aid scheme to support fishing companies to address the increase in fuel prices due to the Middle East crisis. The scheme was approved under the Middle East Crisis Temporary State Aid Framework (METSAF) adopted by the Commission on 29 April 2026.

title: Commission awards €400 million to European projects to decarbonise heat production
